countries.reasoning: China is the world's largest producer of tungsten and by extension, tungsten carbide. Data sourced from USGS 2023, which provides reliable production statistics.
Canada has several tungsten mines contributing to the global tungsten carbide market. Data is from Canadian government surveys and industry reports, which are generally reliable.
Russia has significant tungsten deposits and contributes to global tungsten carbide production. Data sourced from Russian geological surveys; slight reporting delays occasionally occur.
Austria's tungsten production is well-documented by its national mining ministry; the contribution of tungsten carbide follows suit.
South Korea imports substantial amounts of raw tungsten to produce tungsten carbide. Data from South Korean government and industry surveys; slight uncertainties due to mixed production figures.
